fields.notes: Fast learning curve in basic TeTe bols.

fields.name: SATURDAY BATCH 1 (5 TO 6)
fields.description: Foundational bols: Dha, Ge, Na, Ti, TeTe. Teentaal Kaydas.

fields.name: SUNDAY BATCH 2 (9 TO 11)
fields.description: Khanda and Rupak layakari, Relas and Farrukhabad Tukdas.

fields.lesson_topic: Introduction to Delhi Kayda theme & first palta

fields.name: Teentaal
fields.theka_notation: Dha Dhin Dhin Dha | Dha Dhin Dhin Dha | Dha Tin Tin Ta | Ta Dhin Dhin Dha
fields.notes: The king of rhythmic cycles in North Indian classical music (Hindustani sangeet). Foundational for Riyaz and solo presentations.

fields.name: Jhaptaal
fields.theka_notation: Dhi Na | Dhi Dhi Na | Ti Na | Dhi Dhi Na
fields.notes: Prominent 10-beat cycle with Khanda chhanda. Extensively used in vocal Khyal and classical solo.

fields.name: Ektaal
fields.theka_notation: Dhin Dhin | DhaGe Tirakita | Tu Na | Kat Ta | DhaGe Tirakita | Dhi Na
fields.notes: Symmetrical 12-beat taal popular for Vilambit (slow) and Drut (fast) khyal accompaniment as well as solo.

fields.name: Rupak
fields.tali_khali_info: Khali on 1 (Sam treated as Khali/Tali convention); Tali on 4, 6
fields.theka_notation: Tin Tin Na | Dhi Na | Dhi Na
fields.notes: Unique cycle starting on Khali. Essential for vocal, sitar/sarod, and semi-classical accompaniment.

fields.name: Keharwa
fields.theka_notation: Dha Ge Na Ti | Na Ka Dhi Na
fields.notes: Very popular 8-beat taal for Bhajans, Ghazals, Folk music, and light classical accompaniment.

fields.name: Dadra
fields.theka_notation: Dha Dhi Na | Dha Tu Na
fields.notes: Lively 6-beat cycle common in Thumri, Dadra, and devotional music.

fields.title: Dha TeTe Dha TeTe DhaGeNaTi Basic Kayda (Delhi Gharana)
fields.bol_notation:
Theme (Mukh): 
Dha Te Te Dha Te Te | Dha Ge Na Ti Ta Ke |
Ta Te Te Ta Te Te | Dha Ge Na Ti Dha Dha ||

Palta 1 (Double Dha TeTe):
Dha Te Te Dha Te Te | Dha Te Te Dha Te Te |
Dha Te Te Dha Te Te | Dha Ge Na Ti Ta Ke |
Ta Te Te Ta Te Te | Ta Te Te Ta Te Te |
Dha Te Te Dha Te Te | Dha Ge Na Ti Dha Dha ||

Tihai:
Dha Te Te Dha Ge Na Ti | Dha - S - S |
Dha Te Te Dha Ge Na Ti | Dha - S - S |
Dha Te Te Dha Ge Na Ti | Dha (Sam) ||
fields.practice_instructions: Ensure clear separation between Daya (Chanti) and Baya (Dagga). Keep TeTe crisp with middle and index finger.

fields.title: Dhire Dhire Kitataka Delhi Rela
fields.bol_notation:
Dhi Re Dhi Re Ki Ta Ta Ka | Dhi Re Dhi Re Ki Ta Ta Ka |
Ti Re Ti Re Ki Ta Ta Ka | Dhi Re Dhi Re Ki Ta Ta Ka ||
fields.practice_instructions: Focus on wrist balance and steady stamina. Gradually accelerate by 10 BPM increments.

fields.title: Traditional Farrukhabad Tukda
fields.bol_notation:
DhaGeTirakita DhaGeNaTi | KatTa GadiGhene Dha - |
KatTa GadiGhene Dha - | KatTa GadiGhene Dha || (Sam)
fields.practice_instructions: Crisp Nikas on GadiGhene with distinct open bayan resonance.

fields.title: Damdar Tihai in Teentaal
fields.bol_notation: Dha Tit Ki Ta Tak Dha (S) | Dha Tit Ki Ta Tak Dha (S) | Dha Tit Ki Ta Tak Dha (Sam) ||
fields.practice_instructions: Maintain exact rest (Dam) of 1 matra between the three phrases.
